description: This file defines memory allocation functions and macros for a Redis-related project, with support for different malloc implementations and optional defragmentation features.

methods.name: zcalloc
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory of specified size.

methods.name: zrealloc
methods.description: Reallocates memory to a new size.

methods.name: zmalloc_get_allocator_info
methods.description: Provides info about allocated, active, and resident memory.

methods.name: zmalloc_get_private_dirty
methods.description: Gets private dirty memory for a process.

methods.name: zmalloc_get_smap_bytes_by_field
methods.description: Gets smap bytes by field for a process.

methods.name: zfree_no_tcache
methods.description: Frees memory without thread cache, if defrag is enabled.

methods.name: zmalloc_no_tcache
methods.description: Allocates memory without thread cache, if defrag is enabled.

methods.name: zmalloc_usable
methods.description: Returns usable size of allocated memory.
